unit.why: A single narrative: a learned melamed who kept away from the Besht dreams of the Besht's teaching, and the Besht summons him and draws him close.

stories.start_quote: בק"ק מעזיבוז הי' עשיר אחד שלא
stories.end_quote: נתקרב אליו בכל לבו ונעשה צדיק גמור
stories.summary_en: A scholarly melamed in a rich opponent's house in Medzhybizh dreams on Friday night of a wondrous palace where the Besht teaches Torah; a servant bars him from entering. He forgets the teaching and grieves all Sabbath. At the third meal the Besht sends for him, repeats the very teaching, and jokes that it is nothing new; the melamed becomes his devoted follower and a perfect tzaddik.
